units: offset from the true price p in units of 30 bps; ask above p, bid below p; knots at own displacement ln(spot/p) = -8..+8 x 30 bps; add arb_flag to both offsets right after an own arb trade
fees: askFee = 1 - exp(ln(spot/p) - ask*0.003); bidFee = 1 - exp(-bid*0.003 - ln(spot/p)); clamp to [0, 0.10]
